why_ai: Undifferentiated workflow SaaS faces AI-native legal tools; trust accounting compliance keeps some stickiness.
why_clarity: Features like timekeeping, deadlines and reconciliation have defined, checkable outputs.
why_digital: Software built, delivered and sold online to law firms.

why_ai: Change detection over a bounded, public, web-published rules corpus is a well-posed monitoring task for AI.
why_clarity: A deadline computed from a rule is exact and its rules can be written down.
why_digital: Court websites in, deadline calculations out, delivered in software.

why_ai: The bottleneck is media review, exactly what transcription and video indexing automate.
why_clarity: Time-to-reviewable is measurable, and the transcription and indexing pipeline is standard.
why_digital: Body-camera video and digital discovery in, indexed media out; public procurement is slower.

why_ai: Published forms and evidence requirements make case management and policy propagation automatable.
why_clarity: Form-driven cases follow published requirements, but policy shifts mid-case.
why_digital: Forms and evidence handled entirely in software sold online.

why_ai: Bill-review reduction rules are deterministic, machine-applied, and return structured outcomes.
why_clarity: Invoices are reduced or not by machine rules, with results returned as structured data.
why_digital: Mandated electronic billing in a specified format, entirely digital.

why_ai: Rationing scarce legal help needs defensible judgment, but eligibility screening and referral are rule-governed.
why_clarity: Eligibility rules are explicit at huge volume, but referral outcomes are rarely tracked.
why_digital: People describe problems by phone or web; grant-funded buyers buy through relationships.

why_ai: Machine translation of intake, documents and status updates directly replaces the bilingual intermediary.
why_clarity: Translated client communications are well defined and recur on every case.
why_digital: Documents and messages translated and delivered digitally to client-facing firms.

why_ai: Record retrieval, exposure proof and lien work are document-heavy, rule-governed tasks AI automates.
why_clarity: Forty thousand near-identical claimant files with checkable proof requirements.
why_digital: Medical records and claim documents processed entirely on screen.

why_ai: Continuous activity signals and the lawyer's own edits make timesheet reconstruction a pure ML task.
why_clarity: Accepted-unedited share is measured instantly by the lawyer's daily edits.
why_digital: Computer activity logs in, timesheets out.

why_ai: Intake scoring and case valuation are structured prediction tasks, ambiguous by venue and carrier.
why_clarity: Case value is checkable against settlements, but those arrive months or years later.
why_digital: Intake and medical data in, scores and demand packages out.

why_ai: Operational-leverage software for contingency firms faces AI-native case management competitors.
why_clarity: Throughput and case selection metrics are measurable across many similar matters.
why_digital: Software sold to and used by firms entirely online.
